description: Store the frustration classification of open cases from fetch_unmut_offen: eintraege [{signal_id, unmut: kein|leicht|stark, beleg: short VERBATIM quote from nachricht (max 120 chars; omit for kein)}], at most 50 per call. The server checks the level and that the quote is verbatim (otherwise the shortened message is used); kein deletes the stored message. Only open cases of this tenant; others are rejected with a reason. Analyse-Agent, server, tenant admins and superadmins.

eintraege.description: Classifications: [{signal_id, unmut, beleg}], max 50 per call
